phase1.explanation:
🦀 **Reqwest is the most popular HTTP client in Rust.**

**HTTP client features:**

| Feature | Code |
|---------|------|
| GET | `reqwest::get(url)` |
| POST | `client.post(url).json(&data)` |
| Headers | `.header("key", "value")` |
| Query params | `.query(&params)` |
| JSON | `.json()` / `.json::<T>()` |
| Timeout | `.timeout(duration)` |

**Rust-chan says:**
"Reqwest is the standard HTTP client. Use it for API calls."

**When to use HTTP clients:**
| Situation | Use HTTP |
|-----------|----------|
| API calls | ✅ |
| Web scraping | ✅ |
| Microservices | ✅ |
| Cloud services | ✅ |

error[E0308]: mismatched types
 --> src/main.rs:6:18
  |
6 |     let response = reqwest::get("https://httpbin.org/ip").await;  // ERROR!
  |                  ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ expected `Result<Response, Error>`, found `()`
  |
  = note: this error originates in the macro `$crate::assert` which comes from the expansion of the macro `assert` (in Nightly builds, run with -Z macro-backtrace for more info)

For more information about this error, try `rustc --explain E0308`.
phase2.explanation:
You forgot to handle the Result from reqwest.

**The fix:**
```rust
let response = reqwest::get("https://httpbin.org/ip").await?;
```

**Rust-chan says:**
"HTTP requests can fail. Handle errors."
